fixedCases.falsifier: Fail if February or April is invented, an expected month is omitted, or the 09:00 America/Chicago wall time shifts.
Fail if the nonexistent 2027-03-14 02:30 local occurrence is shifted into another instant or if later 02:30 local occurrences move.
Fail if the 2027-11-07 overlap produces two occurrences or chooses the later 01:30 CST instant.

recurrence.storedScheduleReadback: Register the monthly rule under the queue and fixed key with timezone America/Chicago; require getSchedule to report kind rrule, the same expression, queue name, and timezone. Require getSchedule to return null after unschedule.
recurrence.proofLimit: This proves the pinned pg-boss schedule API, schema-44 persistence/readback, preview path, and bundled rrule-temporal behavior for these bounded fixtures. It does not implement the Obligations recurrence engine or pass R1 recurrence ATs.
